job.title: HelioGrid synthetic product pitch
job.objective: Explain how a unified operating view can shorten the decision path

inputs.user_prompt: Create a concise three-slide product pitch from the synthetic company note. Emphasize operating clarity, not unsupported financial outcomes.

company.name: HelioGrid
company.one_liner: A synthetic operating-intelligence concept for distributed energy teams

brand.typography: normal-width modern sans-serif with tabular numerals and two weights
brand.shape_language: precise grid, thin structural lines, restrained radii, no floating card wall
brand.image_direction: editorial infrastructure realism with subtle topographic and energy-flow cues
brand.logo_policy: no logo supplied; render the company name as exact text without inventing a mark

evidence_cards.claim: The current synthetic workflow contains four handoffs
The proposed synthetic workflow contains two handoffs: unified intake and prioritized action
The intended audience is an operations leadership team

narrative.thesis: HelioGrid reframes fragmented operational signals into one shorter decision path
storyline: A unified intake creates one operating picture
A shorter path clarifies the next action
assumptions: The workflow description is a synthetic concept, not a measured deployment
omissions: No financial, market, customer, or performance claims supplied

slides.title: One operating view. A shorter decision path.
slides.purpose: Establish the product thesis and visual identity
slides.key_message: HelioGrid turns fragmented operating signals into a coherent action path

content.text: One operating view. A shorter decision path.

visual.layout: asymmetric editorial cover with a wide left title field and a single infrastructure-flow hero on the right
visual.reading_path: title to hero flow to quiet subtitle
visual.dominant_object: one integrated energy-network flow moving toward a single control point

image2.direction: Premium institutional cover with tactile infrastructure detail and large calm negative space.

slides.title: Four handoffs fragment the operating picture
slides.purpose: Show why the current process creates decision friction
slides.key_message: Multiple handoffs separate signals from the people who must act

content.text: Four handoffs fragment the operating picture
Signals move across separate steps before a priority becomes visible.

visual.layout: left-to-right broken process occupying the lower two-thirds, with the headline and metric anchored above
visual.reading_path: headline to metric to interrupted process

image2.direction: Use restrained discontinuities and routing friction, not warning-sign clichés.

slides.title: Two steps connect signal to action
slides.key_message: Unified intake and prioritized action form one clear decision loop

content.text: Two steps connect signal to action
One operating picture makes the next action easier to see.

visual.layout: one continuous horizontal path with a broad evidence intake on the left and a decisive action focus on the right
visual.reading_path: headline to two-step path to conclusion

image2.direction: Resolve the flow visually from distributed inputs into one confident action plane.
